$comment: The one place that pins the catalog sources (ADR 0012). `npm run snapshot` reads it, fetches every input at these pins and writes catalog/stock-registry.v0.json, catalog/snapshot.lock.json, catalog/coverage.json and the runtime artifacts derived from them. Two codegen-x pins (ADR 0012 addendum): codegenX.commit is the Stock content BuildY reads; ui8kit.sourceCommit is the commit registry.buildy.tw was built from. They may differ only when the Stock commit descends from the registry commit and publishes byte-identical variants and props.
